content: Search APIs (blog sources, dates 2026): Tavily 1,000 free credits/mo no card, pay-as-you-go ~$8/1k, returns extracted content, SDK @tavily/core 0.7.12. Exa: $10/mo free allowance, neural search, exa-js 2.22.0. Brave: free plan removed Feb 2026, $5/mo credit needs card, $5/1k queries, no official npm SDK (community brave-search 0.9.0 stale). SearXNG: self-hosted JSON API ?format=json. DuckDuckGo: only unofficial scrapers (duck-duck-scrape 2.2.7, Jan 2025). Ollama web search: ollama.webSearch/webFetch in ollama-js 0.6.3, needs free ollama.com key.
